The '''GalaxyGuard Mk. VII''' was a brand of [[Shield booster/Legends|shield boosters]] for [[Starship/Legends|spaceships]] manufactured by [[BvK Fleet Systems]]. Up to three GalaxyGuard Mk. VII boosters could be stacked to provide greater endurance and range for a ship's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. One such booster could be purchased on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="JGG" /> at some point before the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] took place in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], and the [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]] [[Death/Legends|died]] during the film. As Tyerell was shown to be alive in ''[[Star Wars Math: Jabba's Game Galaxy]]'', the events of the game must have taken place before the events of ''The Phantom Menace''.</ref>
